title: A worker as the video compositor
blurb: A worker reads video frames from a MediaStreamTrackProcessor, draws transferred ElementImage snapshots of live HTML over them and writes a video track. The picture and the track keep running while the main thread is blocked.
question: Can a worker compose camera or video frames with snapshots of live DOM and produce a video track, with no captureStream() and no work on the main thread per frame?
result: Yes, through transferred streams. Chromium 157 has neither MediaStreamTrackProcessor nor VideoTrackGenerator in a worker, so the page makes both ends and transfers their streams.
